extracted.intended_audience: journalists, media professionals, researchers, and members of the public looking for EPA news releases
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for locating and filtering U.S. EPA news releases by topic, date, office, geography, and language, and for contacting media staff or subscribing to releases. Focused on using the EPA Newsroom Browse News Releases page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Releases by subject
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subjects listed include: Administrator; Agriculture; Air and Radiation; Awards and Recognition; Climate; Compliance and Enforcement; Emergency Response; Energy; Grants; Hazardous Waste; Inflation Reduction Act; Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act; International; Lead; Partnerships and Stewardship; Pesticides and Toxic Chemicals; PFAS; Research; Superfund and Brownfields; Trash and Recycling; Tribal; Underground Storage Tanks; Water. "Learn more about EPA: main topics on EPA's web site."

rubrics_metrics.name: Keyword search
rubrics_metrics.description: Search the news releases list by keywords.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instruction: "at the top of the news releases list page, you can also search by keywords." Example: enter "asbestos" to find news releases with that word in the headline and/or text of the news release.

rubrics_metrics.name: Releases by date
rubrics_metrics.description: Filter news releases by release year and access archives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit filter options shown: Filter by release year (2021, 2020 and 2019). Also: "Search the archive for older news releases" and "Selected historical press releases."

rubrics_metrics.name: Releases by office (headquarters offices)
rubrics_metrics.description: Filter news releases by EPA headquarters office or issuer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offices listed include: Office of the Administrator (AO); Air and Radiation (OAR); Chemical Safety and Pollution Prevention (OCSPP); Chief Financial Officer (OCFO); Enforcement and Compliance Assurance (OECA); General Counsel (OGC); International and Tribal Affairs (OITA); Land and Emergency Management (OLEM); Research and Development (ORD); Water (OW); plus an option for "All headquarters releases (including all news releases by the offices listed above)". Note: "not all EPA offices generally issue news releases." Link: "Learn more: How EPA headquarters offices are organized."

rubrics_metrics.name: Releases by location or region (state and regional filters)
rubrics_metrics.description: Filter news releases by U.S. state, territory, or EPA region/press office.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A long list of selectable states and territories (e.g., Alabama, Alaska, American Samoa, ... Wyoming). Press office selections: Headquarters; Region 1; Region 2; Region 3; Region 4; Region 5; Region 6; Region 7; Region 8; Region 9; Region 10. Link: "Learn more: About EPA regional offices."

rubrics_metrics.name: Releases by language
rubrics_metrics.description: Filter news releases by available language translations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Languages listed: English; Español (Spanish); Tiếng Việt (Vietnamese); 中文: 简体版 (Simplified Chinese); 中文: 繁體版 (Traditional Chinese); Français (French); Kreyòl ayisyen (Haitian Creole); (Arabic) عربى; 한국어 (Korean); Português (Portuguese); Pусский (Russian); Tagalog (Tagalog).

rubrics_metrics.name: Media contacts / press officer contact
rubrics_metrics.description: Contact information and resources for media inquiries and press officers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Related Resources include: Regional contacts; Headquarters contacts; "Contact a press officer at headquarters: press@epa.gov"; Media Contacts and Broadcast Services. Use these contacts for press inquiries or to reach a press officer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscription and alternative newsroom resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Options to receive news releases and access related newsroom services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Links and options listed: "Sign up to receive news releases and other information from EPA." "Get News Releases in your Inbox"; Newsroom; EPA Live Events; Search News Releases; EPA Social Media; Broadcast Services; Contact Us about Newsroom. These are ways to subscribe, follow, or access live/broadcast services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Historical releases and archives
rubrics_metrics.description: Access to older news releases and selected historical press releases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit pointers: "Read News Releases prior to 2019" and "Selected historical press releases." Also: "Search the archive for older news releases." Useful for locating legacy announcements.
